    tsdst.estimators.BayesLogRegClassifier.__init__¶

    BayesLogRegClassifier.__init__(C=None, start=None, niter=10000, algo='rosenthal', algo_options=None, retry_sd=0.02, retry_max_tries=100, initialize_weights='sklearn', param_summary='mean', has_constant=False, verbose=True, over_dispersion=False, scorer=None)[source]¶

    The constructor for the BayesLogRegClassifier

    Parameters:
    Cfloat, optional

    Positive inverse regularization setting. The coefficient-prior scale is 2*C for Laplace priors on the slopes. If None, the posterior samples the prior scale on the log scale. The default is None.

    startarray-like, optional

    Parameter vector on the sampled scale. The first value is the intercept. Extra distribution or prior parameters follow the regression coefficients. If None, initialize_weights selects a finite start. The supplied vector is copied and its length and posterior support are checked.

    niterint, optional

    The number of MCMC samples to draw. The default is 10000.

    algostr, optional

    The MCMC (Metropolis) algorithm to use. The default is ‘rosenthal’, which is a method that tunes the covariance matrix after each iteration. Other options include ‘rwm’, which is a simple random metropolis walk with a fixed covariance matrix, and ‘lap’ which is another adaptive method that tunes the covariance matrix every K iterations.

    algo_optionsdict, optional

    The options to be passed to the MCMC algorithm. Include as a dictionary. The default is None.

    retry_sdfloat, optional

    Standard deviation of normal noise added to the starting parameters on every fifth attempt after a Cholesky failure. The default is 0.02.

    retry_max_triesint, optional

    Retry threshold after a failed Cholesky decomposition. The default is 100. The wrapper retries the sampler with a perturbed start; it does not directly jitter the proposal covariance matrix.

    initialize_weights{‘sklearn’, ‘zeros’, ‘ones’, ‘random’}, optional

    Initialization rule when start is None. The default is ‘sklearn’, which uses a scikit-learn logistic fit as a warm start. The sampled prior-scale extra starts at zero for the sklearn and zeros rules.

    param_summarystr, optional

    Chain summary: ‘mean’, ‘median’, ‘mode_kde’, or ‘mode_histogram’. Any other value, including ‘final_sample’ and ‘last_value’, selects the final sample. The default is ‘mean’.

    has_constantbool, optional

    Whether or not the data provided already has a column of ones as the first column in the dataset for the intercept of the model. If not, one is created. The default is False.

    verbosebool, optional

    Retained estimator setting. Sampler progress is controlled by the progress entry in algo_options. Sampler acceptance and retry summaries may be printed independently. The default is True.

    over_dispersionbool, optional

    Retained argument. The binary Bernoulli posterior does not sample a separate dispersion parameter. The default is False.

    scorerfunction or str

    The function or string to use for the default scoring method. Otherwise, pass None for accuracy. The default is None.

    Returns:
    None.
